name: What are the benefits of expanding my bathroom versus just remodeling it?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of expanding my bathroom versus just remodeling it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expanding your bathroom offers distinct benefits over a standard remodel, primarily by increasing usable space. This allows for the inclusion of premium features like a larger walk-in shower, freestanding tub, double vanity, or dedicated storage. It enhances comfort, functionality, and can significantly boost home value and appeal, particularly in luxury properties where spacious bathrooms are a key selling point. A remodel refreshes aesthetics; an expansion transforms functionality and scale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expanding provides more space for added features and better functionality, significantly increasing comfort and home value, unlike a standard remodel that primarily refreshes aesthetics.
